EC1: Administration of HES [OR], dextrane solutions [OR] or > 500 ml of Gelatin solutions within the 24 h prior to randomization
EC2: Death expected within the next 48 h (moribund patients as defined by ASA = class V)
EC3: Patients whose medical condition does preclude the PLR manoeuvre
EC4: Patients for whom the need of pressure infusions are expected
EC5: Requirement for renal support (either continuous or discontinuous techniques, including intermittent haemodialysis, haemofiltration and haemodiafiltration)
EC6: Patients receiving therapeutic heparin medication due to chronic coagulation disease / an [OR]ticoagulation medication (i.e. partial thromboplastin time > 60 sec)
EC8: Contraindications according to summary of product characteristics of investigational test and reference product
EC9: Simultaneous participation in another interventional clinical trial (drugs or medical devices studies)
